cohort: Primiparous women referred to one private midwifery center and two public hospitals in Ahvaz, Iran.
finding: Women receiving team midwifery care experienced significantly higher rates of normal vaginal birth and exclusive breastfeeding, and their neonates had higher first- and fifth-minute Apgar scores and a lower rate of admission to intensive care unit, compared to women receiving routine care.
mod_finding: Women in the team midwifery care group experienced significantly higher rates of normal vaginal birth compared to women in the control group.
